entities.name: Oana Vitellius
entities.description: An Azorius defender who later becomes an arbiter, granddaughter of Otho Vitellius II; she is tricked by a Dimir agent into a memory-transfer bargain.

entities.name: Tarem
entities.description: A Dimir agent who offers Oana a memory transfer from her dead grandfather and returns decades later to collect his payment.

entities.name: Arbiter Johvann III
entities.description: A monotone Azorius arbiter who sentences Oana's client for selling medicinal supplies without a license.

entities.name: Otho Vitellius II
entities.description: Oana's late grandfather, a famous Azorius arbiter who dedicated his life to punishing the Dimir.

entities.name: Petri
entities.description: A young Lyev soldier who testifies against the vegetable merchant.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The governing body of the Azorius guild, whose authority Oana invokes.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The law-enforcing guild of Ravnica in which Oana serves.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild of spies and manipulators to which Tarem belongs.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A guild whose member is accused in the theft case Tarem wants Oana to rule on.

entities.name: Sova Column
entities.description: Azorius research teams from which Oana was promoted.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius city-seat where courts and Oana's work are located.

entities.name: Rowan Lane market
entities.description: The market where the vegetable merchant was arrested.

events.summary: Oana sprints late through New Prahv to the courtroom where she is to defend a client.
events.quote: Oana clutched an armful of scrolls as she sprinted down the echoing halls of New Prahv.

events.summary: Arbiter Johvann has Arrester Petri recount that the accused announced 'Fresh vegetables for sale.'
events.quote: the accused made the following public announcement from his vegetable stand, and I quote: 'Fresh vegetables for sale.'

events.summary: Johvann explains that vegetables were reclassified as medicinal supplies and convicts Oana's client, seizing his stock and revoking his permits.
events.quote: You are found guilty of selling medicinal supplies without a license.

events.summary: In a bar, Oana rants that she is broken and cannot keep up, blaming herself for her client's ruin.
events.quote: I can't keep up, and a decent man lost his business because of me.

events.summary: Tarem introduces himself and offers Oana a proposal.
events.quote: My name is Tarem. I have a proposal for you.

events.summary: Tarem offers memory transfer from her dead grandfather to Oana.
events.quote: It can transfer the memories and training from the dead to the living.

events.summary: Oana recognizes Tarem as Dimir and angrily refuses, vowing to destroy the Dimir.
events.quote: I will continue his work, and I will earn the right to destroy you.

events.summary: Oana, newly driven, wins five trials the next day without being late.
events.quote: And she wasn't late for a single one.

events.summary: Decades later Oana is an esteemed arbiter with thirty years of service.
events.quote: Arbiter Oana Vitellius I tucked her graying hair into her traditional judge's cowl and smiled at her reflection.

events.summary: Oana finds Tarem, unaged, waiting in her home.
events.quote: Tarem. He hadn't aged a day.

events.summary: Tarem demands she acquit an unknown accused in an Izzet League theft case as payment.
events.quote: you will find him innocent of all charges. This will mark the end of our transaction.

events.summary: Tarem asks when she last saw her granddaughter; Oana realizes she has no grandchildren and the memory of the offer was altered.
events.quote: She had never married, and had no children, let alone grandchildren.

events.summary: Flashback: Oana's true memory of the night restored, in which she reasoned the transfer was legal and agreed to it.
events.quote: Distasteful, certainly. But legal. I believe it would be legal.

events.summary: Oana recalls she agreed to one favor to be named later.
events.quote: "One favor to be named later. And I agreed."

events.summary: Oana resigns, confesses and recuses herself from her cases, seeking a lawyer.
events.quote: Oana spent the next morning writing her letter of resignation and her official statement of confession.

relations.quote: Oana Vitellius, granddaughter of the famous arbiter, Otho Vitellius II.
The Dimir agent bowed politely and made an unhurried exit.

relations.note: served the Azorius for thirty years
relations.quote: thirty years of service to the Azorius

relations.note: she vows to destroy the Dimir
relations.quote: I will continue his work, and I will earn the right to destroy you.
